@bdxi/web3js 1.0.1

Manrope variable font, packaged by @fontsource-variable/manrope 5.3.0

SIL Open Font License 1.1: ./licenses/manrope-LICENSE.txt

The Belroll mark, interface icons and share graphic are authored SVGs in this
repository. No external asset requests or hosted fonts are required.
